@graph.name: Things to Do in Playa Flamingo, Costa Rica
@graph.description: The best things to do in Playa Flamingo, Costa Rica: Gold Coast beaches, catamaran sails, Catalina Islands diving, day trips and seasonal events, all minutes from Casa Nina.

@graph.name: Casa Nina Flamingo
@graph.description: A seven-bedroom luxury villa for large groups and multigenerational stays, steps from Playa Flamingo beach on Costa Rica's Gold Coast. Sleeps fourteen across two independent living units, with an elevator and a dedicated concierge included with every stay.

@graph.name: Playa Flamingo
@graph.description: A white-sand beach community on the Gold Coast of Guanacaste, Costa Rica, known for calm swimmable water, Marina Flamingo, world-class sportfishing, the Catalina Islands and Pacific sunsets.

includesAttraction.name: Playa Flamingo Beach
includesAttraction.description: Protected white-sand crescent with calm, swimmable water and Pacific sunsets.

includesAttraction.name: Marina Flamingo
includesAttraction.description: Full-service marina and departure point for sportfishing charters and catamaran sails, five minutes from Casa Nina.

includesAttraction.name: Playa Conchal
includesAttraction.description: Beach of crushed shells with clear turquoise water, ten minutes away.

includesAttraction.name: Catalina Islands
includesAttraction.description: Volcanic islets with premier diving and snorkeling; giant Pacific manta season runs November to April.

includesAttraction.name: Las Baulas National Marine Park
includesAttraction.description: Protected nesting grounds at Playa Grande where leatherback turtles nest from October to March.

includesAttraction.name: Reserva Conchal Golf Course
includesAttraction.description: Robert Trent Jones II championship course above Conchal beach.

includesAttraction.name: Rincón de la Vieja National Park
includesAttraction.description: Active volcano with fumaroles, waterfalls, hanging bridges, hot springs and mud baths, about ninety minutes inland.

includesAttraction.name: Palo Verde National Park
includesAttraction.description: Wetland river safaris on the Tempisque with monkeys, crocodiles and more than 280 bird species.

includesAttraction.name: Llanos de Cortés Waterfall
includesAttraction.description: Wide curtain waterfall with a sandy, swimmable pool, roughly seventy minutes away.

includesAttraction.name: Tamarindo
includesAttraction.description: Surf town twenty-five minutes south with beginner-friendly breaks, shopping and dining.

mainEntity.name: How do we get from the airport to Casa Nina Flamingo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Liberia International Airport (LIR) is about 60 minutes from the villa, and every Casa Nina booking includes airport pick-up and drop-off arranged by the concierge team.

mainEntity.name: Do we need to rent a car in Playa Flamingo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Golf carts (4 or 6 passenger) are street-legal on all local roads, and the concierge arranges golf cart or car rentals on request, with cars in all different sizes for larger groups.

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to visit Playa Flamingo?

acceptedAnswer.text: December to April is the Guanacaste dry season, with reliable sunshine and calm seas. May to November is the green season: full waterfalls, quieter beaches and the best value.

mainEntity.name: Who arranges tours and activities during a stay at Casa Nina?

acceptedAnswer.text: A dedicated concierge is included with every stay. Boat charters, private chefs, transport, spa days and excursions are arranged before guests land and throughout the stay.
